info.title: UC Davis IAM API
info.description:
This API provides resources for querying and modifying identity data collected from various sources by the Identity
and Access Management (IAM) team. It is intended for use by developers that need to integrate identity data into their
applications.

externalDocs.description:
```
###TYPES###

##Groups##
type GroupBucket {
  sourceName: String
  sourceId: String
  groups: [String]
}

type GroupSource {
  sourceName: String
  sourceId: String
}

type GroupMembership {
  name: String
  iamid: String
  loginId: String
  employeeId: String
  email: String
  groups: [GroupBucket]
}

type GroupMember {
  name: String
  iamid: String
  email: String
}

type GroupById {
  groupName: String
  groupSource: String
  groupId: String
  groupMembers: [GroupMember]
}

##People##
type ProvisioningStatus {
  primary: String
}

type NameRecord {
  lived_first_name: String
  lived_middle_name: String
  lived_last_name: String
  legal_first_name: String
  legal_middle_name: String
  legal_last_name: String
}

type IdentityIds {
  iam_id: String
  login_id: String
  student_id: String
  mothra_id: String
  employee_id: String
  mail_id: String
  pidm: String
  pps_id: String
  cosmos_id: String
  cpe_id: String
  health_affiliate_id: String
  ucanr_id: String
  usda_whnrc_id: String
  affiliate_id: String
  ucnet_id: String
}

type EmailAddresses {
  primary: String
  work: String
  personal: String
}

type PhoneNumbers {
  primary: String
  work: String
  personal: String
}

type StudentAssociation {
  college: String
  major: String
  academic_level: String
  class_level: String
}

type PayrollAssociation {
  employee_record: String
  employee_id: String
  position_number: String
  position_title: String
  relationship_to_organization: String
  employee_classification: String
  employee_classification_description: String
  status: String
  hire_date: String
  start_date: String
  termination_date: String
  fte_percentage: String
  reports_to_position: String
  job_type_id: String
  job_type_description: String
  job_family_id: String
  job_family_description: String
  organization_id: String
  organization_title: String
  division_id: String
  division_title: String
  subdivision_id: String
  subdivision_title: String
  business_unit_id: String
  business_unit_title: String
  department_id: String
  department_title: String
  department_short_title: String
  reports_to_iam_id: String
  reports_to_employee_id: String
}

type Person {
  iam_id: ID
  displayname: String
  birth_date: String
  manager_iam_id: String
  provisioning_status: [ProvisioningStatus]
  affiliation: [String]
  employment_status: [String]
  name: [NameRecord]
  id: [IdentityIds]
  email: [EmailAddresses]
  phone: [PhoneNumbers]
  student_association: [StudentAssociation]
  payroll_association: [PayrollAssociation]
  modified_date: String
  create_date: String
}

##Position Association##

type PpsAssociationRecord {
  iam_id: String
  reports_to_iam_id: String
  reports_to_employee_id: String
  employee_id: String
  employee_record: String
  position_number: String
  position_title: String
  relationship_to_organization: String
  employee_classification: String
  employee_classification_description: String
  status: String
  hire_date: String
  start_date: String
  termination_date: String
  fte_percentage: String
  reports_to_position: String
  job_type_id: String
  job_type_description: String
  job_family_id: String
  job_family_description: String
  organization_id: String
  organization_title: String
  division_id: String
  division_title: String
  subdivision_id: String
  subdivision_title: String
  business_unit_id: String
  business_unit_title: String
  department_id: String
  department_title: String
  department_short_title: String
  is_health_employee: String
  is_campus_employee: String
  modified_date: String
  create_date: String
}

##Student Association##
type SisAssociationRecord {
  iam_id: String
  pidm: String
  student_id: String
  college_code: String
  college_title: String
  major_code: String
  major_title: String
  lvl_affiliation_code: String
  cls_affiliation_code: String
  rank: String
  modified_date: String
  create_date: String
}

##College Info##
type College {
  college_code: String
  college_title: String
}

##Major Info##
type Major {
  major_code: String
  major_title: String
  major_status: String
}

##Meta Info##
type Meta {
  x_total_count: Int
  x_response_count: Int
}

###INPUTS###
###Query parameter / filters for queries###
input PeopleFilterInput {
  iamid: String
  firstname: String
  lastname: String
  manager_iam_id: String
  iamids: [String]
  email: String
  emails: [String]
  loginid: String
  employeeid: String
  studentid: String
  mailid: String
  pidm: String
  mothraid: String
  pps_id: String
  cosmos_id: String
  cpe_id: String
  health_affiliate_id: String
  ucanr_id: String
  usda_whnrc_id: String
  affiliate_id: String
  ucnet_id: String
  affiliationContains: String
  employmentStatus: String
  count: Boolean = false
  modifiedsince: String
  limit: Int = 10000
  offset: Int = 0
}

input CollegesFilterInput {
  college_code: String
  college_title: String
}

input MajorsFilterInput {
  major_code: String
  major_title: String
  major_status: String
}

input GroupsFilterInput {
  source: String
  limit: Int = 10000
}

input GroupMembershipFilterInput {
  iamid: String
  iamids: [String]
  email: String
  loginid: String
  employeeid: String
  source: String
  limit: Int = 10000
}

input GroupsByIdFilterInput {
    id: String!
    limit: Int = 10000
}

input PpsAssociationFilterInput {
    iamid: String
    iamids: [String]
    loginid: String
    employeeid: String
    jobtypeid: String
    organizationid: String
    departmentid: String
    divisionid: String
    subdivisionid: String
    count: Boolean = false
    modifiedsince: String
    sortBy: String
    SearchAfter: String
    offset: Int = 0
    limit: Int = 1000
}

input SisAssociationFilterInput {
    iamid: String
    iamids: [String]
    pidm: String
    studentid: String
    majorcode: String
    collegecode: String
    count: Boolean = false
    modifiedsince: String
    sortBy: String
    SearchAfter: String
    offset: Int = 0
    limit: Int = 1000
}

##Results##
type PeopleResult {
  results: [Person]
  meta: Meta
}

type PpsAssociationResult {
  results: [PpsAssociationRecord]
  meta: Meta
}

type SisAssociationResult {
  results: [SisAssociationRecord]
  meta: Meta
}

type MajorsResult {
  results: [Major]
}

type CollegeResult {
  results: [College]
}

type GroupsResult {
  results: [GroupBucket]
}

type GroupSourceResults {
  results: [GroupSource]
}

type GroupMembershipResult {
  results: [GroupMembership]
}

type GroupByIdResult {
  results: GroupById
}

##Query types##
type Query {
  #Colleges
  colleges(filter: CollegesFilterInput): CollegeResult

  #Majors
  majors(filter: MajorsFilterInput): MajorsResult
  
  #People
  people(filter: PeopleFilterInput): PeopleResult
  people_students(filter: PeopleFilterInput): PeopleResult
  people_employees(filter: PeopleFilterInput): PeopleResult
  people_faculty(filter: PeopleFilterInput): PeopleResult
  people_external(filter: PeopleFilterInput): PeopleResult
  
  #Groups
  groups(filter: GroupsFilterInput): GroupsResult
  groupSources: GroupSourceResults
  groupMembership(filter: GroupMembershipFilterInput): GroupMembershipResult
  groupById(filter: GroupsByIdFilterInput): GroupByIdResult

  #Position Association
  ppsassociation(filter: PpsAssociationFilterInput): PpsAssociationResult

  #Student Association
  sisassociation(filter: SisAssociationFilterInput): SisAssociationResult
}
```

sourceName.description: Human-friendly source system name (e.g., "Google Workspace", "Active Directory").

sourceId.description: Identifier for the source system (typically an application/tenant id).

groups.description: List of group identifiers/names from the source system.

Person.description: An object containing identity data about a user.

PPSAssociation.description: An object describing a payroll association

SISAssociation.description: An object describing a student association

Authorization.description:
Used to send a valid OAuth 2.0 access token.

Example:
  Authorization: Bearer {token}

The token must contain the scopes required by each operation
(see the "scopes" list in this security scheme).

401.description:
Unauthorized - Bad or expired token. This can happen if the user or IAM
team has revoked or expired an access token. To fix, you should obtain
a new token from the token endpoint.

403.description:
Forbidden - The access token is valid but does not contain the required
scopes for this resource. Check the "scopes" defined in this security
scheme and ensure the client requests the correct ones.
